title: Threads, visibility, and shared state — Module Quiz
description: Course assessment: Prevent lost updates when two workers count orders.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: Is volatile int count followed by count++ an atomic counter?

options.text: Only if count starts at zero

questions.explanation: volatile does not make read-modify-write atomic.

questions.prompt: Which Thread method schedules a new thread?
questions.explanation: start creates the independent execution; run is its body.

options.text: A wait for a thread to finish, with completion visibility guarantees
A guarantee of execution order between all threads
An automatic lock on every object

questions.explanation: A successful join establishes the required completion relationship.

questions.prompt: Which operation safely increments one shared integer?
questions.explanation: The atomic operation prevents lost updates.

questions.prompt: What is one common cause of deadlock?

options.text: Opposing acquisition order for shared locks

questions.explanation: Cyclic lock dependencies can leave threads waiting forever.

questions.prompt: Is every multi-step operation on ConcurrentHashMap automatically atomic?
questions.explanation: Use compute, merge, or another suitable atomic operation for compound updates.

options.text: The code cannot compile because AtomicInteger is mutable
